C0694.title: JD.com Launched a Campaign Against Malicious Dropshipping Store Networks
keywords: JD.com campaign against malicious dropshipping store networks
C0694.summary: On December 5, 2025, JD.com launched a campaign against improper business practices, focusing on malicious networks of stores operating without their own inventory. JD.com said these operators commonly copied listings from other stores, resold goods at higher prices, and placed orders with third-party merchants only after receiving customer orders, creating fulfillment, logistics, and after-sales problems. The platform subsequently issued risk notices and strengthened enforcement to protect consumers and fair competition.
